name: Hiding Tomb
prompt: Original The Last Light stylized dark fantasy game asset. One heavy ancient stone tomb chest with a tall flat lid partly slid aside and a deep dark recess under it. Broad stone body with carved relief, solid stable low base. An isolated sarcophagus-like monument, no bodies, no skeleton, no scene. Single isolated complete 3D object, three-quarter studio view showing front, side and top, matte painterly materials. Plain solid light gray background, even neutral diffuse light, full silhouette with margin. No text, no scenery, no smoke, no fire, no additional views.
